a.lede: The company's shares have plummeted in response to the exec's affair with an alleged Chinese spy.
a.title: NVIDIA shareholders are suing the company and CEO Jensen Huang

b.lede: Nvidia's board of directors is investigating a report about Jensen Huang's alleged affair with a client, claims it is still confident in Jensen and leadership team.
b.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang admits to having an affair with suspected Chinese spy
